subject: world
title: From Crawler to Flyer
objective: Observe and name the life-cycle stages: egg → caterpillar → cocoon → butterfly.

story_beats.text: Bobo lifts his magnifier. 'What do you NOTICE? The caterpillar didn't stay a caterpillar. It CHANGED!'
First an egg. Then a hungry caterpillar. Then a quiet cocoon. Then — a butterfly with wings!

interactions.prompt: Put the life cycle in order!
Inside the cocoon, the caterpillar is...

feedback.correct: You noticed the great change! Bobo is writing it in his notebook!
feedback.retry: Look carefully — what came FIRST? The tiny egg!

off_screen: Find a picture of a butterfly. What colours are its wings?
parent_note: Science: life cycles, observation, sequencing natural change.
